faqs.qEn: What is the exact capsule count and milligram strength of Horsemen?
faqs.aEn: Each authentic bottle of Horsemen (SKU: ONYX-HM-20, MPN: HM-500MG-20MY) contains 20 capsules at 500mg per capsule, providing 10,000mg (10g) of concentrated botanical extracts per bottle.
faqs.qMs: Berapakah bilangan kapsul dan kekuatan miligram sebenar bagi sebotol Horsemen?
faqs.aMs: Setiap botol tulen Horsemen (SKU: ONYX-HM-20, MPN: HM-500MG-20MY) mengandungi 20 kapsul dengan kepekatan 500mg setiap kapsul, memberikan jumlah keseluruhan 10,000mg (10g) ekstrak herba bagi setiap botol.

faqs.qEn: How does Horsemen differ from Hammer of Thor (both 20-capsule formulations)?
faqs.aEn: Horsemen is formulated around a 100:1 Malaysian Tongkat Ali + Black Peruvian Maca + Epimedium + Korean Red Ginseng matrix designed for rapid evening readiness and dual-mode intake. Hammer of Thor focuses specifically on high-saponin Tribulus Terrestris inside 100% vegetarian capsules for progressive daily physical stamina conditioning.
faqs.qMs: Apakah perbezaan antara Horsemen dan Hammer of Thor memandangkan kedua-duanya mempunyai 20 kapsul?
faqs.aMs: Horsemen dirumus dengan tumpuan ekstrak Tongkat Ali 100:1, Maca Hitam Peru, Epimedium dan Ginseng Merah Korea untuk kesediaan tenaga malam yang pantas serta penggunaan dwi-mod. Hammer of Thor pula menumpukan kepada Tribulus Terrestris bersaponin tinggi di dalam kapsul vegetarian untuk bina stamina fizikal harian.

faqs.qEn: Can I take Horsemen if I drink kopi or teh tarik in the evening?

faqs.qEn: Is Horsemen a prescription drug or synthetic medication?
faqs.aEn: No. Horsemen is a traditional botanical and amino-acid dietary supplement formulated for adult men (18+) to support physical vitality, stamina, and daily nutrition. It is free from undeclared synthetic PDE5 adulterants and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
